shortDescription: Manages galera hostgroups using the proxysql admin interface

options.name: active
options.description: Enabled (1) or disabled (0) defined hostgroup configuration.

options.name: backup_writer_hostgroup
options.description: Id of the hostgroup that will contain all the Galera nodes that are standby writers.

options.name: comment
options.description: Text field that can be used for any purposes defined by the user.

options.name: config_file
options.description: Specify a config file from which I(login_user) and I(login_password) are to be read.

options.name: load_to_runtime
options.description: Dynamically load config to runtime memory.

options.name: login_host
options.description: The host used to connect to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: login_password
options.description: The password used to authenticate to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: login_port
options.description: The port used to connect to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: login_unix_socket
options.description: The socket used to connect to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: login_user
options.description: The username used to authenticate to ProxySQL admin interface.

options.name: max_transactions_behind
options.description: maximum number of writesets behind the cluster that ProxySQL should allow before shunning the node to prevent stale reads

options.name: max_writers
options.description: number of Read-Write instances populated in the writer hostgroup

options.name: offline_hostgroup
options.description: Id of the hostgroup all failed nodes will be moved to.

options.name: reader_hostgroup
options.description: Id of the hostgroup that will contain all the Galera nodes that are readers.

options.name: save_to_disk
options.description: Save config to sqlite db on disk to persist the configuration.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present) - adds the galera hostgroup, when C(absent) - removes the galera hostgroup.

options.name: writer_hostgroup
options.description: Id of the hostgroup that will contain all the Galera nodes that are active writers.

options.name: writer_is_also_reader
options.description: writer_is_also_reader - 0 nodes with `read_only=0` will be placed either in the writer_hostgroup and in the backup_writer_hostgroup after a topology change, these will be excluded from the reader_hostgroup writer_is_also_reader - 1 nodes with `read_only=0` will be placed in the writer_hostgroup or backup_writer_hostgroup and are all also placed in reader_hostgroup after a topology change writer_is_also_reader - 2 Only the nodes with `read_only=0` which are placed in the in the backup_writer_host
